tei:div.tei:p: "!# dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: 'chi med tshe yi skor gyi phyi dbang gnad zab tshe'i dbang bskur bzhugs so:1$0000250zangs shog dmar po'i chos sde'o:1$0000300

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ghu ru tshe dpag med la na mo: gnad zab tshe yi dbang bskur sbyin pa ni: slob dpon mchog la lo gsum snga gong nas: gsol ba gdab cing dbang gi zhu ba gsol: nyams rtags tshad du phyin pa'i bla ma yis: phyi dbang bum pa'i gtor ma gnas su bskur: nang dbang yab yum lus dkyil spyi bor bskur: gsang ba byang chub bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog myang: thog mar phyi dbang bskur ba yar ngo'i dus: mchod gtor tshe bum yo byad sta gon bya: bdag bum lhar bskyed bsnyen sgrub dbang blang zhing: slob bu khrus byas bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom: zhal du bda' zhing sku la reg 'jam dang: thugs la bde ba'i dbang gi 'jug yon dbul: lag tu me tog phreng ba thogs nas ni: kye ma: ghu ru yab yum rigs lnga tshe yi bdag: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba kun gyi sku: 'chi med tshe sgrub rig pa mchog gi mdzod: bdag la tshe yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum mo: bla mas lan sbyin pa ni: rtsod dus bskal pa'i snyigs ma 'dir: 'chi med grub pa'i skal can ni: nyin skar tsam zhig mthong bas na: khyod ni skal bar ldan nam ci: zhes dri: slob mas: bdag ni gsang ba dam pa'i snod: log rtog the tshom dri ma med: ghu ru yab yum thugs rje yis: bdag cag brtse bas bzung du gsol: zhes gsum mo: de nas slob ma ghu ru bdag nyid ni: longs sku dkar dmar tshe bum 'dzin pa: yab kyi sku'i nang du pad sdong brtsegs mar tshe bdag rigs lnga dang bcas pa bsgoms la: mi bskyod tshe dpag med kyi thugs kar g.yung drung ris dmar po'i 'od kyis lho nub rnga yab gling nas pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag yab yum gyi sku: tshe lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa mang po spyan drangs la bstim pa ni: byin dbab pa ste: snod du rung bar byed pa'o: de nyid brtan par bya zhing: ngo sprad de dbang bskur ba dngos ni: tshe zan: a mṛta dang: swa bhā was bsang zhing sbyangs la:

stong par bsam: de'i ngang las: tshe zan phyi dbyibs ghu ru yab yum dang: nang du tshe bdag rigs rnams tshe bum dang: yum rnams mda' dar rang rang gi mdog can 'dzin pa: g.yon tshe bum can du bskyed la: yum rnams kyi mda' dar las 'od zer 'phros pas: tshe bkug cing lha so so'i sku dang tshe bum la bstims par dmigs: phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu mda' dar g.yab cing: 'di skad do: oṃ: bcom ldan mgon po rnam snang tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku yi 'phro 'du las: 'gugs byed lha mo dkar mo'i pho nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum thogs nas stong khams nyul: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi: tshe 'thor yar nyams yo gas 'khyams ral zhig: phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung por shor ra re: sprul pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul stobs ma zhan: thugs rje'i rtsal gyis tshe dpal dbang du sdus: 'chi med bum pa tshe rten 'di la khug: oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ dza: hrī: bcom ldan mgon po pad+ma tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku yi 'phro 'du las: smin byed lha mo dmar mo'i pho nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum thogs nas stong khams nyul: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi: lus bkrag drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams te: phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung por shor ra re: sprul pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul stobs ma zhan: me yi khams nas drod kyi bcud sdus la: 'chi med bum pa tshe rten 'di la khug: hrīḥpad+ma ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ dza: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku yi 'phro 'du las: sdud byed lha mo sngon mo'i pho nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin nas stong khams nyul: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi: lus mdangs khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams te: phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung por shor ra re: sprul pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul stobs ma zhan:

chu yi khams nas gsher gyi bcud sdus la: 'chi med bum pa tshe rten 'di la khug: hūm̐ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ dza: trāṃ: bcom ldan mgon po rat+na tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med= brtan byed lha mo ser mo'i= mda' dar tshe= bdag dang rgyu sbyor= gzugs phung sha rus khams= phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung por= sprul pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul= sa yi khams nas sra ba'i bcud sdus la: 'chi med bum pa= trāṃ rat+na ā yu= ā: bcom ldan mgon po karma tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med= grub byed lha mo ljang gsal pho nya 'phro: mda' dar tshe bum thogs= bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag= srog 'dzin dbugs kyi khams= phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung= sprul pa'i lha mo= rlung gi khams nas g.yo ba'i bcud sdus la: 'chi med bum pa tshe rten 'di la khug: āḥkarma ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ dza: zhes bstims la: slob bu'i spyi bor bskur te: oṃ: sku yi dbang mchog bud+dha tshe dpag med: zhal gcig phyag gnyis bde chen mnyam par sbyor: dkar gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas: sku yi tshe dbang rab 'byams bskur du gsol: oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa ā+oṃ: mgrin par dbang bskur te: hrī: gsung gi dbang mchog pad+ma tshe dpag med: zhal gcig phyag gnyis bde chen mnyam par sbyor: dmar gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas: gsung gi tshe dbang rab 'byams bskur du gsol: hrīḥpad+ma ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: snying gar bskur te: hūm̐: thugs kyi dbang mchog rdo rje tshe dpag med: zhal gcig phyag gnyis bde chen mnyam par sbyor: mthing gsal 'chi med= thugs kyi tshe dbang= hūm̐ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lte bar bskur te: trāṃ: yon tan dbang mchog rat+na tshe dpag med: zhal gcig phyag gnyis bde chen= ser gsal 'chi med=

yon tan tshe dbang rab= trāṃ rat+na ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: gsang bar bskur te: ā: phrin las tshe dbang karma tshe dpag med: zhal gcig phyag gnyis bde chen= ljang gsal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsang rum nas: phrin las tshe dbang rab 'byams bskur= āḥkarma ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: zhes rgyas par na sku dang bcas te dbang bskur ro: lha rnams kyi bum pa nas bdud rtsi babs pas ghu ru yab yum gyi sku gang ste: sbyor mtshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi babs: slob bu'i gnas so so'i lha rnams kyi bum pa nas gang zhing lud pas: lus gang: sgrib pa lnga dag: ye shes lnga thob: sku lnga mngon du byas par bsam zhing ngo yang sprad do: de nas tshe chang dang: tshe'i pu lu tshe bstims pa yang: tshe yi sngags kyis sbyin zhing brtan par bya'o: rjes rgyas gdab pa ni: bh+rūm̐: ye shes lha mo tshe mda' srung ba'i lha: sna tshogs mdog can rin chen rgyan 'chang ma: 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje rin po che: rgya gram 'bar ba'i phyag rgya rab bkra bas: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi: tshe srog lus zungs dbang thang klung rta'i stobs: phyi nang bar chad mi mthun rkyen rnams las: yongs su srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: zhes tshe mda' gnas so sor gtugs shing sbyin no: lus dang longs spyod gtang rag tu dbul: slob dpon gyis lha la mchod bstod nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad bskang: shis pa brjod: dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bas rgyas btab bo: e ma ho: chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs: de yi drung du pad+ma bdag nyid kyis: lus dang longs spyod ltos med mchod par 'bul: 'chi med tshe yi phyi dbang 'di zhus te: nyams su blangs pas skye 'chi med pa'i lus: rdo rje'i lus 'di grub bo phyi rabs rnams: 'chi med 'dod na lus dang longs spyod bcas: phongs med bla ma rje la phul nas ni:

'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi 'di la 'bad: snying la chongs shig sa ma a tham rgya: 'chi med gsang ba'i phyi dbang rdzogs so: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gnyan rgya: zab rgya: rgya lngas btab te zab chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi 'chi med sgrub pa'i gnad du gdams so: e ma 'di nyid yang zab cho ga ste: ma 'ongs lha sras byang chub sems dpa' yis: 'gro 'dul tshe yi dbang bskur 'di la gyis: 'di nyid yang zab gnad bsdus phyogs tsam bstan: 'di la dgos pa'i tshe yi las gzhung dbang: rgyas par byed na 'grel pa'i sgron me sbor: nga yi bu mchog lha sras snying la phur: sa ma ya: kha thaṃ: nang dang gsang ba'i tshe dbang logs su gab:1$0000250 ༈ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las: 'chi med tshe yi skor las nang gi dbang bskur bzhugs so:1$0000300 zangs shog dmar po'i chos sde'o: sa ma ya: ❀ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'chi med tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dad pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma la: nang gi dbang bskur ba ni: rin po che dang sman 'bru dar zab snying gi nor phul te: khrus byas bgegs bskrad mig dar bcing: me tog
